channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Pete Myers | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Pete Myers from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Pete Myers
item.description:
“He would say, ‘Hey, Draymond, a couple of things I want you to always remember in this league -- as long as you're dealing with this league, you owe it to the game to leave it in a better place than it was when you found it.’ “And he said, ‘You get paid in this league for the next young guy to get paid.’ It's so often in this league [that] you hear guys complaining about, ‘Oh, man, this young guy is now making this,’ or you hear how an older guy tried to crush a younger guy, and it derails a young guy's career. And[Myers] was always telling me, ‘You get paid for the next young guy in this league to come along to get paid.’”

Draymond Green on Pete Myers, Feb 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Pete Myers
item.description:
“Pete Myers -- I'm sure you know Pete Myers, he was an assistant coach my first two years under Mark Jackson -- he used to tell me a couple of things,”

Draymond Green on Pete Myers, Feb 15, 2026. Source: NBC Sports Bay Area.

item.title: Draymond Green on Pete Myers
item.description:
“Any young guy that will listen, I’ll speak to (former NBA player and assistant coach) Pete Myers (who) told me a long time ago, ‘You owe it to the game to leave it in a better place than it was when you found it.’ And I always try to do that.”

Draymond Green on Pete Myers, Jan 14, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Scottie Pippen on Michael Jordan, Pete Myers
item.description:
“I remember Michael said, ‘Well, we got another one of those Arkansas boys’ when I was drafted. Knowing the Bulls had drafted Pete Myers, he was an Arkansas kid, from the University of Arkansas (at Little Rock). He was actually from Mobile, Alabama. That’s kind of all I remember.”

Scottie Pippen on Michael Jordan, Pete Myers, Apr 15, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Pete Myers, Michael Malone
item.description:
Tim Kawakami:Jackson on replacing Mike Malone:

“More than likely Pete Myers will be my No. 1 assistant,unless there’s an absolute home run out there.”

Mark Jackson on Pete Myers, Michael Malone, Jun 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @timkawakami.

item.title: Mark Jackson on Pete Myers
item.description:
“You won’t find one guy that does not like Pete Myers. They appreciate his honesty. They appreciate how he understands where they are. Whether you play 40 minutes or four, he’s got something for you that’s going to help you.”

Mark Jackson on Pete Myers, Jul 19, 2012. Source: Contra Costa Times.
